why: Cecotti places the retained S,T matrices and explicit Bolza automorphisms in one appendix but does not bind them as the same marked generators.
KRR supplies existence of a conjugating automorphism g but not its lattice/J[2] matrix.
post1648j reduces the generator-pair ambiguity to the +r inner-conjugacy orbit but leaves 24 admissible pairs and all three W-lines.
FSM/Stoll and marked-node assets supply additional source-side actions but no common adapter to the retained principal G12 basis.

legal_next_construction_lanes.objective: Use the explicit G48 generators referenced by KRR/Deraux and the curve-side action to materialize the conjugating g on A[2] or an equivalent exact finite marking, then test the image of phi2*phi6.
legal_next_construction_lanes.why_materially_distinct: Targets the missing common conjugator directly rather than collecting more trace/order invariants.

legal_next_construction_lanes.objective: Bind the curve differential/branch-point marking to the homology basis underlying Cecotti's period matrix, yielding an exact action in the retained lattice basis or a finite residual ambiguity.
legal_next_construction_lanes.why_materially_distinct: Constructs the curve-to-lattice basis bridge from the ppav/period data instead of group-conjugacy existence.

legal_next_construction_lanes.objective: Seek a common level/theta characteristic marking that simultaneously identifies the FSM/Stoll modular action and one retained principal G12 element/product.
legal_next_construction_lanes.why_materially_distinct: Uses the level structure as the semantic anchor required by the formal finite-action router.

decision.reason: KRR already isolates the exact missing object as a conjugating automorphism g, while Deraux is cited as providing explicit G48 generators; a mod-2 realization is the smallest finite target before attempting full period/homology reconstruction.
